entries.title: Container Port to Warehouse Flow
entries.description: A 3D scene where colorful box-shaped shipping containers slide off a large ship, move along conveyor belts and trucks to a warehouse, with crates attaching/detaching from vehicles, stacking, and leaving colored trails that show different product types.
entries.seed: Container Port to Warehouse Flow: A 3D scene where colorful box-shaped shipping containers slide off a large ship, move along conveyor belts and trucks to a warehouse, with crates attaching/detaching from vehicles, stacking, and leaving colored trails that show different product types.

entries.title: Global Supply Web on a Rotating Globe
entries.description: A rotating transparent globe with glowing city nodes connected by pulsing supply routes, where small cargo spheres travel along curved paths, collide at hubs, queue, and transfer between air (flying), sea (floating), and land (rolling) transport links.

entries.title: Factory Assembly and Packaging Line
entries.description: A factory floor where raw material blocks enter on one side, pass through machines that rotate, press, and merge them into products, then wrap them in transparent boxes and send them via branching conveyor belts to different labeled loading docks.
entries.seed: Factory Assembly and Packaging Line: A factory floor where raw material blocks enter on one side, pass through machines that rotate, press, and merge them into products, then wrap them in transparent boxes and send them via branching conveyor belts to different labeled loading docks.

entries.title: Rail Cargo Network with Bottlenecks
entries.description: A rail yard network with multiple tracks where train cars carrying colored cargo cubes attach/detach at junctions, wait at red/green signal posts, and sometimes collide or bounce slightly when queues get too long, with overhead labels showing delays.

entries.title: Just-in-Time Inventory Warehouse
entries.description: A warehouse grid where shelving racks are stationary and autonomous carts glide around picking up and dropping off boxes, with stock levels shown by vertical bar meters that grow/shrink as items transfer between shelves, packaging stations, and loading zones.

entries.title: Cold Chain Temperature Simulation
entries.description: A cooled supply chain where boxes of medicine move through trucks, cold rooms, and loading docks, with each box’s color smoothly shifting from blue (cold) to red (warm) as time passes, and transparent thermometer pillars marking temperature breaches.

entries.title: Supply-Demand Balancing Network
entries.description: A simplified network of supplier spheres and retailer cubes linked by tubes where colored “product particles” flow, split, and merge, and retailer cubes grow or shrink slightly depending on whether incoming particles meet their rotating demand meters.

entries.title: Port Container Stacking and Crane Operations
entries.description: A dockyard with towering stacks of container blocks and tall cranes that swing and lower hooks to attach to containers, lift them, rotate, and place them onto trucks or ships, with occasional misplacements causing containers to bump and slightly slide.

entries.title: Food Supply Chain from Farm to Table
entries.description: A landscape with farms (green patches), a processing plant, a distribution center, and a supermarket, where food crates travel by tractor, truck, and conveyor, changing color and shape at each stage (raw, processed, packaged) and leaving faint path trails.

entries.title: Micro-Scale Supply Chain Inside a Cell
entries.description: A biological analogy where glowing vesicle spheres (cargo) float along filament “tracks” between large organelle structures, attach/detach from motor-protein walkers, fuse with or bud from organelles, and leave shimmering particle trails representing molecular transfers.

entries.title: Resilient vs Fragile Supply Chain Under Disruption
entries.description: Two mirrored networks of supplier nodes and warehouse cubes where one has many redundant paths and the other has single links; randomly appearing “disruption walls” block some paths, causing cargo spheres to reroute, queue, or bounce back in each system.

entries.description: A 3D city block grid where delivery vans and small drones carry packages from a local depot to buildings; packages detach and move up elevators or along drone flight paths, with building demand indicators shrinking as deliveries successfully arrive.
